control_flow: In followLine: if the line tracker reads below 30 %, curve left; else if it reads above 70 %, curve right; else drive straight on.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line from the start, through its curves, all the way to the green goal at its end, staying on the line.

decision_points.condition: first: the line tracker's brightness is below 30 %; second: it is above 70 %

branches.outcome: below 30 % (on the black core): it curves left
above 70 % (white band or peach floor): it curves right
between 30 % and 70 %: it drives straight on
